description: Η προτεινόμενη παρέμβαση αφορά την εκτέλεση βυθοκορήσεων στην ευρύτερη θαλάσσια περιοχή του λιμένα Σούδας και περιμετρικά της επέκτασης του νέου προβλήτα, με στόχο την εξασφάλιση ωφέλιμου βάθους έως 12,50 m. Οι εργασίες περιλαμβάνουν τη διαμόρφωση των απαιτούμενων λειτουργικών βαθών για την εξυπηρέτηση του νέου προβλήτα και του λιμένα, καθώς και τη δημιουργία κελιού περιορισμένης θαλάσσιας διάθεσης (Confined Aquatic Disposal – CAD) για τη διαχείριση μέρους των βυθοκορημάτων. Επίσης στην περιοχή έδρασης του νέου έργου επέκτασης του προβλήτα ‘ΑΔΡΙΑΣ’, το οποίο θα υλοποιηθεί με άλλη εργολαβία με τίτλο: «Κατασκευή Τμήματος Κρουαζιέρας λιμένα ΣούδαςΕπέκταση προβλήτα ‘ΑΔΡΙΑΣ’», θα γίνουν οι απαραίτητες βυθοκορήσεις για την εξυγίανση του πυθμένα με εκσκαφή και αφαίρεση του επιτόπου εδαφικού υλικού σε πάχος 5,0m περίπου, κλιμακωτά ακολουθώντας κατά το δυνατόν το ανάγλυφο του πυθμένα. Τα υλικά που θα προκύψουν από τις βυθοκορήσεις χαρακτηρίζονται ως μη επικίνδυνα και αδρανή και, σύμφωνα με τους εγκεκριμένους περιβαλλοντικούς όρους, τα αδρανή βυθοκορήματα θα διατεθούν σε εγκεκριμένη θαλάσσια περιοχή απόθεσης, ενώ τα μη επικίνδυνα βυθοκορήματα θα ενταφιαστούν εντός του κελιού CAD και θα καλυφθούν με στρώση αδρανών υλικών πάχους τουλάχιστον 3 m.

description: Työnhaun ohjaus ja neuvontapalvelu Mikkelin seudun työllisyyspalveluiden asiakkaille. Työnhaun ohjaus ja neuvontapalvelu on ennakoivaa, työttömyyttä ehkäisevää ja nopeaa työllistymistä edistävää palvelua. Palvelu luokitellaan työnhakuvalmennukseksi. Palvelun tavoitteena on edistää ja nopeuttaa asiakkaiden työllistymistä sekä mahdollistaa asiakkaiden omatoiminen ja tehokas työnhaku. Tavoitteena on tarjota asiakkaille selkeät ja ajantasaiset ohjeet ja työkalut työnhakuprosessin tueksi, vahvistaa asiakkaiden työnhaun taitoja ja lisätä heidän ymmärrystään omasta osaamisestaan, työmarkkinoista sekä yrittäjyydestä. Palvelu on suunnattu Mikkelin seudun työllisyyspalveluiden työnhakijoille, jotka tarvitsevat matalalla kynnyksellä apua työnhakuun, työllistymiseen sekä työelämässä tarvittaviin tietoteknisiin taitoihin tai työllistymisen esteiden tunnistamiseen. Palvelua toteutetaan ensisijaisesti verkossa ja palveluntuottajan järjestämissä tiloissa Mikkelin seudun työllisyyspalveluiden alueella (Mikkeli, Kangasniemi, Juva, Hirvensalmi, Mäntyharju ja Puumala). Toteutuksen pääpaino on verkkowebinaareissa, joita voi itsenäisesti suorittaa ja joihin kuuluu yksilöohjausta. Lisäksi palvelu voi asiakkaan tarpeesta riippuen olla yksilöpainotteista valmennusta tai palvelua voidaan toteuttaa ryhmämuotoisena valmennuksena. Ryhmämuotoisen valmennuksen toteutus voi olla verkossa tai lähivalmennuksena. Myös eri teemaiset infotilaisuudet mahdollisia. Palvelun suunniteltu toteuttamisaika on 1.1.-31.12.2027. Lisäksi mahdollisuus kolmeen (3) yhden vuoden mittaiseen optioon seuraavasti: 1. Optiokausi 1.1.-31.12.2028 2. Optiokausi 1.1.-31.12.2029 3. Optiokausi 1.1.-31.12.2030 Arvio palveluun ohjautuvasta asiakasmäärästä 500 asiakasta / vuosi. Arvio ei sido tilaajaa eikä aseta määräostovelvoitetta tilaajalle. Tarkempi kuvaus palvelusta on ilmaistu liitteenä olevassa palvelukuvauksessa.

title: Denmark – Sewage, refuse, cleaning and environmental services – Syddansk Universitet - Rengøringsservice & Vinduespolering
description: Rengøringsservice og vinduespolering på ca. 14 lokationer under Syddansk Universitet (SDU). SDU er en selvejende institution, der økonomisk og administrativt er afhængig af Staten og undergivet den til enhver tid gældende bekendtgørelse af lov om universiteter (universitetsloven). SDU har pt. 6 campusser, hvor den største campus er placeret i Odense. De resterende 5 campusser er placeret i Esbjerg, Kolding, Vejle, Sønderborg og København. SDU har derudover en række mindre lokationer rundt omkring i Danmark, samt i Flensburg, Tyskland. Der kan læses mere om alle SDU’s lokationer på www.sdu.dk. Yderligere information om SDU kan fås på http://www.sdu.dk/om_sdu, hvor SDU's indkøbspolitik også findes. Rengøringsservice for SDU omfatter løbende indvendig lokalerengøring og rengøringsrelaterede serviceopgaver. Lokaletyperne omfatter bl.a.auditorier, undervisningslokaler, læsesal, studiepladser, kantineområder/frokoststuer, administrative områder i form af kontorer, mødelokaler og grupperum, laboratorier, herunder GMO-laboratorier klasse 1 og 2, isotop klasse B og C samt Biologisk agenser klasse 1 og sektionsstuer mm. Vinduespolering omfatter ind- og udvendig facadeglas, samt polering af internt glas og ovenlys mv. Rengøringsservice og vinduespolering bliver på nuværende tidspunkt udført af eksterne leverandører (udbuddets omfang fremgår udbudsbilag A). Kontraktbilag 2 og 3 m. bilag indeholder en uddybende beskrivelse af den udbudte Ydelse. Udbuddet er ikke opdelt i delaftaler. Dette skyldes et ønske om et ensartet kvalitets- og serviceniveau på tværs af SDU’s lokationer, behovet for effektiv koordinering og styring af rengørings- og vinduespoleringsydelserne samt ønsket om at reducere de administrative omkostninger forbundet med kontraktstyring, opfølgning og fakturering. Endvidere vurderes det, at en samlet kontrakt giver mulighed for stordriftsfordele og en mere fleksibel disponering af ressourcer mellem lokationerne til fordel for både driften og økonomien.

title: Microscale thermophoresis device
description: Microscale thermophoresis device University of Oulu, Biocenter Oulu, seeks a spectral shift and microscale thermophoresis device to characterise qualitatively and determine quantitatively nanoparticle, including protein, interactions in the range of weak to tight binders in solution without immobilization (hereinafter referred to as the "device"). The device must enable the assessment of sample quality and aggregation and differentiating binding events from aggregation. The device will be used for analysis of interactions of fluorescence labelled proteins with small molecules and vesicles. The detection must be independent of the mass ratio of the binding partners. The device must enable fast screening of interactions as well as sensitive affinity measurement. The measurable dynamic range of dissociation constant must be at least in nM -mM range and binding affinity in at least nM -mM range. Low sample consumption (in order of 10 microlitre) and low nanomole of the labeled target is needed for the measurement. The device must enable detection of the interaction based on changes of emission spectrum of exited fluorophore under isothermal conditions and must be able to create a microscopic non-isothermal temperature field (temperature gradient) and determine nanoparticle including protein binding events based on the temperature related intensity change and fluorescence intensity change following thermophoresis under the thermal gradient. Intensity changes and/or spectrum shifts of the fluorescence probe versus ligand concentrations are measured and plotted to calculate the dissociation constant. The device must come with detailed documentation of all features. The device will be part of the Proteomics and protein analysis core facility infrastructure of Biocenter Oulu. The core facility has an open access policy, and the instrumentation and software must be easy to use and maintain. The device must include a user interface to control the operation. The device must be well suited to an academic multi-user environment. The contracting entity has a maximum sum of 189000 € (excluding value-added tax) available for the procurement and cannot accept tenders exceeding this amount. The procurement is partially funded by the European Regional Development Funds (ERDF), BioParts project (A81573).,

title: Germany – Personnel services except placement and supply services – Anzeigenmanagement
description: Die Universität Hamburg (im Folgenden „UHH“) ist als Exzellenzuniversität mit mehr als 43.000 Studierenden und ca. 6.000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern eine der forschungsstärksten Universitäten Deutschlands und gleichzeitig eine der größten Ausbildungseinrichtungen Norddeutschlands. Mit ihrem Konzept der „Flagship University“ in der Metropolregion Hamburg pflegt sie innovative und kooperative Verbindungen zu wissenschaftlichen und außerwissenschaftlichen Partnern. Sie produziert für den Standort – aber auch national und international – die zukunftsgerichteten gesellschaftlichen Güter Bildung, Erkenntnis und Austausch von Wissen unter dem Leitziel der Nachhaltigkeit. Die Universität Hamburg führt ein Offenes Verfahren gem. § 15 VgV zur Gewinnung eines Dienstleisters zur Veröffentlichung von Stellenanzeigen auf unterschiedlichen Stellenportalen durch. Das Ziel des Verfahrens ist der Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung gem. § 21 VgV über einen Zeitraum von maximal vier Jahren. Die UHH sucht eine ausgewiesene Medienagentur für HR/Recruiting/Personalmarketing, mit langjähriger erfolgreicher Etablierung am Markt, die sämtliche mit nationalen und internationalen externen Stellenausschreibungen verbundenen Aufgaben übernimmt. Aufgabe der Medienagentur ist es, die Stellenausschreibungen aufzubereiten und zu veröffentlichen. Hierzu können bspw. etablierte Stellenportale wie StepStone oder Jobware sowie Plattformen wie Academics.de/Zeit.de oder jobs.sciencecareers.org für die Veröffentlichung genutzt werden. Darüber hinaus können auch gleichwertige Plattformen angeboten werden, die die definierten Reichweiten erreichen. Die Portale sind in drei Kategorien eingeteilt, aus denen jeweils mindestens zwei Portale angeboten werden müssen (vgl. Ziff. 15.3). Es wird eine Medienagentur benötigt, die Universität Hamburg dahingehend unterstützt und berät auf geeigneten Plattformen Stellenausschreibungen zu veröffentlichen. Hierzu kann es zukünftigt notwendig sein, dass die Veröffentlichtungsportale wechseln, sodass grundsätzlich auch Veröffentlichungen auf Portalen möglich sein müssen, die nicht im Preis- und Kalkulationsblatt aufgelistet sind (vgl. Ziff. 2 der Unterlage Leistungsbeschreibung und Vertragsbedingungen). Das geschätzte jährliche Auftragsvolumen beträgt ca. 5 Printanzeigen in regionalen und (inter-)nationalen Tageszeitungen und Fachzeitschriften sowie ca. 130 Online-Anzeigen in verschiedenen Layouts. Das jährliche Auftragsvolumen beträgt voraussichtlich 150.000 € netto.

description: SPECIAL NOTICE � INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Office of Acquisitions and Grants Services (OAGS) Acquisition Title: FY26�FY30 precisionFDA Platform Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Acquisition Identification Number: ODT-2026-132021 NAICS Code: 541714 PSC Code: D319 (Cloud Computing) Set-Aside: Small Business (DNAnexus confirmed SB under NAICS 541714) Contract Type: Firm-Fixed-Price IDIQ Period of Performance: 08/10/2026 � 08/09/2030 Estimated Value: $33,000,000 Notice: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Office of Digital Transformation (ODT), Office of Data Analytics and Research (ODAR), Health Informatics Staff (HIS), intends to award a sole-source Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract to: DNAnexus, Inc. 1975 West El Camino Real, Suite 204 Mountain View, CA 94040 This action is being conducted under the authority of FAR 6.302-1 (Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements), pursuant to 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(1). Description of Requirement: The FDA requires continued operations, sustainment, modernization, and cloud support for the precisionFDA platform � a FISMA-authorized, secure, cloud-based collaborative research environment for next-generation sequencing (NGS) assay evaluation, genomics and multi-omics research, and regulatory science applications. The platform supports collaboration between FDA researchers and reviewers, as well as external collaborators and sponsors across multiple FDA centers, including CDER, CBER, CDRH, CVM, and CFSAN. Services to be acquired include: Platform access licenses, cloud computing resources (compute, storage, data transfer on AWS), operations and maintenance, security patching, and technical support Continuation of all current precisionFDA capabilities, including immutable files with chain of provenance, file locking, Government-only spaces, Protected spaces, Review spaces, FHIR Stations, Scientific Challenge Framework, and custom data portal development capability Development and maintenance of the precisionFDA High (FISMA High) platform on FDA GovCloud FedRAMP Class C (Moderate) and FISMA High compliance maintenance per NIST SP 800-53 Rev5 Integration support for FDA enterprise systems including the Global Substance Registration System (GSRS) Training, user support, disaster recovery, and business continuity services Place of Performance: Contractor facility and FDA White Oak Campus, 10903 New Hampshire Avenue, Silver Spring, MD 20993 Basis for Sole Source Determination: Comprehensive market research was conducted in accordance with FAR Part 10, evaluating 20 vendors with a detailed assessment of 8 shortlisted vendors against 33 critical capability requirements. The research conclusively determined that DNAnexus is the only vendor capable of meeting FDA's requirements for Day-1 continuity of the precisionFDA mission on the date of contract award, for the following reasons: Only vendor with zero capability gaps: DNAnexus is the only vendor that scored fully across all 33 assessed capabilities. No alternative vendor can replicate on Day 1 the precisionFDA capabilities of immutable files with chain of provenance, file locking, Government-only spaces, Protected spaces, Review spaces, FHIR Stations, the Scientific Challenge Framework, or custom data portal development capability. Unique secure external collaboration capability: DNAnexus is the only platform provider able to facilitate secure FDA-sponsored scientific challenges and controlled communication with industry sponsors, vendors, academic researchers, and international regulatory partners while maintaining regulatory-grade confidentiality controls, data segregation, audit trails, and compliance features. Institutional knowledge and validated workflows: FDA has invested over seven years in developing, validating, and documenting bioinformatics workflows on the precisionFDA platform. Over 300 FDA scientific reviewers, bioinformaticians, and research scientists have been trained on the platform. The application library includes 100+ versioned apps. Migration to an alternative platform would require complete revalidation and an estimated $14.7M full rebuild. FedRAMP and FISMA compliance: DNAnexus holds FedRAMP Class C (Moderate) authorization (Cert ID FR1814557199, confirmed June 18, 2026) and FISMA Moderate ATO (FDA-sponsored). DNAnexus is actively enrolled in the PRISM High-Impact Platform Pilot (March 2026) providing a structured pathway to FedRAMP High authorization, with a parallel FISMA High ATO track to support the precisionFDA High platform. Small Business: DNAnexus is confirmed as a Small Business under NAICS 541714 (~277 employees; 1,000-employee size standard). description: Services Requirement This requirement is for: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada Title: 20260726-IRB – Language Testing for Interpreters Description of the Requirement: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada has a requirement for service of testing components and test assessments for the recruitment of their interpreter contractors to Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada (IRB). Interpreter Services Contractors (ISCs) accredited by the IRB must successfully complete three (3) language tests with a minimum score of 70% to qualify for a contract: • Official Languages Test: Assesses the applicant’s ability to communicate in English or French. This is the first test administered, consisting of a short 15-minute written assessment designed to evaluate comprehension in one of the official languages. • Hearing Simulation (Oral) Test: Evaluates the applicant’s ability to perform consecutive interpretation between an official language and a target language, and vice versa. These tests are currently available in sixty (60) languages. However, there are only two versions of each language test, and the quality and consistency of the tests vary. • Sight Translation Test: Measures the applicant’s ability to translate short documents similar to those that may be presented in a hearing room from the language of interpretation to English or French. This is the final test administered. Level of Security Requirement: Resource(s) Minimum Security Level Required is Reliability Status. Associated Documents: Request for Proposal (RFP) 20260726-IRB.
